route.title: Browse a sample database as an interactive website
route.whyChosen: These are the three documented steps (install from the checkout with the dev dependency group, generate fixtures.db, serve it on the default port 8001); the `uv run ` prefix in docs/contributing.rst:146 is dropped because the sandbox has no uv, and the install uses `-e .` from the checkout rather than PyPI.

steps.title: See the map: install from the checkout, tests/fixtures.py builds fixtures.db, `datasette serve` serves it on port 8001
Install datasette from the checkout with the dev group

trapsToWarn: The README never says `pip install -e . --group dev` needs pip 25.1 or newer; older pip fails with "no such option: --group", so run `python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip` first.
The docs write the fixtures step with a `uv run ` prefix; without uv, drop the prefix and run `python tests/fixtures.py fixtures.db` directly.
`--extra-db-filename=A=B` fails if fixtures.db already exists: the script refuses to overwrite it unless you pass --recreate.
A misspelled flag such as `--recrate=` is rejected with "No such option"; the script only accepts the exact flag names (here `--recreate`).
